ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure is an energy flow schematic diagram; the arrow of solar energy flowing to producers is labeled 20,950 kcal; in the energy flow from producers through herbivores to carnivores, the arrow entering carnivores is labeled 328 kcal. Reasoning: The question asks to calculate the percentage of the energy taken in by producers that ultimately reaches carnivores. Calculating according to the values in the figure: (328 / 20,950) × 100 ≈ 1.5656%, rounded to the nearest tenth is 1.6%.

raw_record.question_text: The figure above shows the flow of energy in a community. What percent of the energy taken in by producers ends up in carnivores? Express your answer as a percent to the nearest tenth.

method.method_draft: From the image, first identify the total energy taken in by producers: 20,950 kcal. Then identify the energy that reaches carnivores: 328 kcal. Compute the percentage as (328 / 20,950) × 100 and round to the nearest tenth, giving 1.6%.

method.method_draft: From the image, calculate the fraction of producer intake passed to herbivores: 3,135 / 20,950. Then calculate the fraction of herbivore energy passed to carnivores: 328 / 3,135. Multiply these two fractions and convert to a percent: (3,135/20,950) × (328/3,135) × 100. Round the result to the nearest tenth, yielding 1.6%.
